elbow.depthSwitch: unresolved for pronation/supination; profile depth is not encoded by the front line master
elbow.outsideCurrent2DRange: 超过约 35° 的深屈肘、肘向后穿袖和前臂跨躯干均不可信
elbow.preferredBendBranch: 向屏幕左侧轻微屈曲；保持手腕不穿过袖口/躯干，禁止肘部分支翻转

shoulder.depthSwitch: unresolved beyond small frontal-plane test; shoulder rotation under sleeve is not visible
shoulder.outsideCurrent2DRange: 大于约 20° 的抬臂、明显前后摆和肩胛滑动均超出当前二维线稿证据
shoulder.preferredBendBranch: 保持肘点在躯干外侧，优先沿屏幕左下方分支，不穿过躯干

wrist.depthSwitch: unresolved; bracelet occludes the wrist skin and cannot be used to invent depth
wrist.outsideCurrent2DRange: 大于约 18° 的背屈、旋前旋后和手链环绕深度切换留待后续证据
wrist.preferredBendBranch: 小幅向屏幕左下/右下分支，保持掌根与手链同一腕部支点

depth.back: anatomical right projects to screen-right; hair/shirt may occlude the shoulder root
depth.front: arm hangs lateral to torso; sleeve is foreground at shoulder; forearm-owned bracelet is foreground at wrist
depth.side: arm is lateral to shirt body; forearm skin exits the sleeve opening and hand is distal

canonicalBody.fixedSegmentRule: one set of segment lengths; view projection may shorten apparent length within declared 5% QA tolerance

handAxisReference.role: hand direction/extent reference only; not a fourth joint

canonicalBody.identityRule: front screen-left is anatomical right; back projection reverses screen placement
canonicalBody.model: one articulated right arm projected into front/side/back
canonicalBody.supportRelation: shoulder is supported by the torso/scapular volume; sleeve is an occluding garment, not a substitute for the hidden arm root

coordinateSystems.sideRegistration: screenSide and anatomicalSide are recorded on every view projection; side profile is depth evidence, not a second body

historicalComparison.use: comparison-only; V25 is not inherited as R1 fact

identity.definition: 正面画面左侧手臂，即角色解剖学右臂
identity.subject: 小星 Left

jointAnglesAtRest.interpretation: near-extended hanging arm; angles are structural measurements, not action keyforms

elbow.anatomicalCenter: humeroulnar hinge center between upper-arm and forearm axes
elbow.frontPlacementRule: 取袖口出臂处上臂—前臂骨轴的铰链中心；不取任一侧皮肤外轮廓

palmRoot.frontPlacementRule: 只用于掌部方向和手段长度参考，不计入关节数量

shoulder.anatomicalCenter: glenohumeral joint center / humeral-head center projection
shoulder.frontPlacementRule: 在袖山覆盖下取肩关节中心的投影；不取头发线、肩部外轮廓或袖口端点

wrist.anatomicalCenter: radiocarpal joint center at the forearm-to-palm transition
wrist.frontPlacementRule: 取手链下方两侧腕部轮廓之间的中轴、并与掌部方向相接；不落在任一边缘；手链只遮挡外观，不改变腕关节支点

elbow.note: 原线稿没有可独立认定的肘褶线；支点是由骨轴和局部宽度推导
elbow.observedBasis: 袖口下方可见前臂宽度、侧视袖口出臂截面、固定肩腕骨长

shoulder.note: 皮肤肩根被袖子遮挡；此处是物理体积截面候选，不是可见皮肤 mask
shoulder.observedBasis: 前视袖山、袖口方向、侧视袖内上臂根和背视肩线共同约束

wrist.note: 手链遮挡下的皮肤截面未直接可见；不可从 V38 皮肤/手链旧材料填充
wrist.observedBasis: 手链两侧对称包络、前臂末端轮廓、手掌根方向

observedDerivedUnresolved.conclusion: 袖山、袖口和三视图肩线可见，皮肤肩根不可见
以袖山/躯干体积、固定骨长和侧背投影共同定位肩支点
肘点由肩腕固定骨长、袖口下皮肤宽度和三视图投影求得，原线无独立肘褶
腕点由前臂末端、手掌根方向和手链外轮廓共同定位
手链下方隐藏皮肤的完整截面不能从 V38 旧材料或默认遮挡推断
单独侧视无法独立区分解剖侧，只作为同一身体的厚度/遮挡证据

scope.braceletTreatment: bracelet is an attached subregion owned by forearm; no separate moving layer is required for this R1

stage: R1 physical body, joints, and line semantics

v38RegressionEvidence.regressionUse: semantic ownership and complete material geometry must be rebuilt before any downstream stage
